summary: Complete testing of Find Schools page redesign with 6 Apple-inspired UX features. All 6 features are implemented and functional. Found 1 data inconsistency bug: UCLA on user's board has name 'UCLA' but knowledge base has 'University of California – Los Angeles – UCLA' causing 'On Your Board' status to not display.

minor.issue: Region filter using regex matches partial strings - 'West' returns 'Midwest' results

ui_bugs.issue: UCLA shows 'Add to Board' instead of 'On Your Board' due to name mismatch between programs collection ('UCLA') and knowledge base ('University of California – Los Angeles – UCLA')

feature_1_spotlight_hero.details: Hero card shows #1 match with school name, 91% match score, 'Why this school?' section, match reasons (Division Match, Preferred Region, Athletics, Academics), Add to Board and Website buttons. Carousel shows 'MORE MATCHES - 12 total' with mini cards showing logos and scores.

feature_2_filter_pills.details: Horizontal division pills (D1/D2/D3/NAIA/JUCO) are color-coded (D1=emerald, D2=blue, D3=violet, NAIA=orange, JUCO=yellow). Region and Conference pills present. Clicking D1 filters results from 1053 to 347. Active pills highlighted with division colors.

feature_3_quick_look_expansion.details: Clicking grid card expands inline showing full-width card with pink accent line, school details, division/region/conference info, coaching staff section, Add to Board/Website/Close(X) buttons. Close button closes expansion.

feature_4_grid_list_view_toggle.details: Toggle buttons in search bar switch between grid (3-col cards) and list (detailed rows) views. Grid view is default. List view shows logos, names, match %, regions, division badges, conferences, coach names, and Add to Board buttons.

feature_5_smart_buckets.details: Preset filter buttons present: 'All Schools', 'Dream Schools (D1) 347', 'Strong Match (80%+) 12', 'Close to Home', 'Strong Academics 12'. Active bucket has pink background. Clicking 'Dream Schools' filters to D1 division correctly.

feature_6_sticky_search.details: Search bar sticks to top on scroll with glassmorphism blur. Active filter chips appear below search bar showing 'D1' with X dismiss button and 'Clear all' link. Search shows results count (e.g., '347 results' when D1 filtered).

add_to_board.details: Add to Board works for new schools. But 'On Your Board' checkmark status NOT showing for UCLA due to name mismatch bug.

pagination.details: Shows 'Showing 1-48 of 1053' with Prev/Next buttons when results exceed 48 per page.

grid_card_hover.details: Grid cards have hover-lift animation (translate-y-1) and pink top accent line on hover.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): UCLA university_name mismatch - programs collection has 'UCLA' but knowledge base has 'University of California – Los Angeles – UCLA'. This prevents 'On Your Board' status from displaying correctly.
VERIFY: When adding schools from knowledge base, ensure university_name is copied exactly from knowledge base to programs collection
OPTIONAL: Consider adding 'Close to Home' and 'Strong Academics' smart bucket filtering logic (currently only Dream Schools D1 and Strong Match 80%+ have functional filters)
critical_code_review_comments: The boardSchools Set comparison uses exact string match but UCLA was added with different name than knowledge base entry
All 6 Apple-inspired UX features are implemented correctly with proper data-testid attributes
Suggestion scores correctly calculated with match_reasons array
Filter pills correctly color-coded by division
Expanded card shows coaching staff when available

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all features working except UCLA On Your Board status)

seed_data_creation: Test added and removed a D3 school during add_to_board test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Find Schools page redesign complete with 6 features. Key bug: UCLA name mismatch between programs ('UCLA') and knowledge base ('University of California – Los Angeles – UCLA') causes On Your Board status to not display. Test user pro@test.com has UCLA on board. All data-testid attributes are present and working.

rca_of_issue.issue: UCLA shows 'Add to Board' instead of 'On Your Board'
rca_of_issue.root_cause: Data inconsistency - programs collection stores university_name as 'UCLA' but knowledge base has 'University of California – Los Angeles – UCLA'. The boardSchools.has(uni.university_name) check fails due to exact string mismatch.
reproduction_steps: Observe the UCLA card shows 'Add to Board' button instead of 'On Your Board' status
rca_of_issue.suggested_fix: When adding schools via /api/knowledge-base/add-to-board, the university_name should be exactly what's in the knowledge base. Check if UCLA was added via a different flow that didn't use the knowledge base university_name.
